## Description

_Please include a summary of the change and which issue is fixed. Please also include relevant motivation and context. List any dependencies that are required for this change._

## Type of Change

Please delete options that are not relevant.

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring (no functional changes, no API changes)
- [ ] Chore (updating dependencies, etc.)

## Health Checks

- [ ] I have run `pnpm sanity` (build + format) and it passed.
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation.
- [ ] I have checked my code and corrected any misspellings.

## Screenshots / GIFs (if applicable)

Please attach screenshots or GIFs of the changes if they are visual.

## Checklist:

- [ ] My PR has a descriptive title.
- [ ] I have linked the issue I am working on.
- [ ] I have updated the `README.md` if needed.
- [ ] All new and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes.
- [ ] Any dependent changes have been merged and published in downstream modules.
